name: PromptBuilder
summary: Constructs and formats LLM prompts for AI query and correction workflows.
purpose: Isolates prompt engineering and templating logic from AI service orchestration, ensuring consistent, schema-aware, and context-rich prompts are generated for LLM interactions.
responsibilities: Build base prompts for natural-language-to-query translation via .build()
Build correction or refinement prompts via .build_correction()
Serialize structured schemas into textual prompt context via ._schema_to_text()
Enforce consistent prompt structure and formatting conventions
Abstract prompt construction details from the AIQueryService orchestrator
inputs: User natural language query or intent
Previous LLM response and correction instructions (for corrections)
outputs: Formatted prompt strings optimized for LLM consumption
Textual schema representations embedded in prompts
architecture_notes: Serves as a dedicated builder within the backend AI service layer, applying a Builder-like pattern to construct prompts for distinct use cases (query generation vs. correction). It decouples prompt formatting from AIQueryService, allowing prompt strategies to evolve independently. The private ._schema_to_text() method internalizes schema serialization, suggesting a potential hidden dependency on schema metadata formats.
improvements: Extract ._schema_to_text() into a separate SchemaFormatter utility to improve testability and single-responsibility compliance
Introduce explicit PromptTemplate or PromptStrategy abstractions to support versioning and experimentation
Add comprehensive type hints and input validation for all public build methods
Evaluate converting to stateless functions if no instance state is required, reducing object lifecycle overhead
Implement token-budget awareness and truncation logic to prevent prompt overflow with large schemas
